Fellside 2-person tent

$289.00

About this tent

The Fellside is a freestanding two-person tent that pitches inner and flysheet together in under four minutes, so the sleeping area stays dry when you set up in the rain.

Two doors and two porches mean neither person has to climb over the other at night, and each porch is deep enough for a pair of boots and a rucksack. The flysheet is a silicone-coated ripstop nylon with a hydrostatic head of three thousand millimetres, and the poles are aluminium.

At 1.9 kilograms packed, it is light enough for a long weekend on foot but roomy enough that two adults can sit up and play cards when the weather keeps them inside.

Specifications

  • Packed weight: 1.9 kg
  • Floor area: 2.9 square metres
  • Peak height: 105 cm
